campaign.title: 🚀 New Retail Partner Programme
campaign.body:
Namaste Ramesh! 🙏

JK Cement is expanding its retail network in your area. Become an official JK Cement Retail Partner and enjoy:

✅ Direct factory pricing
✅ Real-time order tracking
✅ Festive schemes & rewards
✅ AI-powered ordering support

Tap Register Now below to get started!

submitted.title: Application Received
submitted.body:
Dear Ramesh Patel,

Thank you for submitting your application to become a Retail Partner of JK Cement.

Our team will review your details and get back to you shortly. You will be automatically notified on this channel for any queries or upon successful registration.

We look forward to welcoming you as a partner!

welcome.title: 🎉 Welcome to JK Cement Retailer Network!
welcome.body:
Congratulations Ramesh Patel! 🎉

Your store Ganesh General Stores is now an approved JK Cement Retail Partner.

Tap Open Menu below to access your self-service dashboard — place orders, check schemes, view invoices, and more.

campaign.title: 🏗️ Construction Season Offer
campaign.body:
Stock up for the construction season! 🧱

JK Super OPC & PPC at special trade prices. Bulk orders above ₹50,000 get extra 3% discount + free delivery.

Limited period offer — order now!

scheme.title: 💰 Current Scheme — Grey Cement
scheme.body:
Buy 100 bags JK Super OPC 53 Grade → Get 5 bags FREE + ₹2,000 ZoPs credited to your account.

Valid till 31 Dec 2026.

Tap below to place your order with scheme pricing applied automatically.

aiTyping.body: Scheme query detected, ZoAi is composing a response...

aiResponse.title: ZoAi Scheme Explanation
aiResponse.body: Bhai, is scheme mein aapko har 100 bags OPC 53 par 5 bags FREE mil rahe hain. Matlab aap 100 bags ka pay karenge aur 105 bags ka maal milega. Plus ₹2,000 ZoPoints jo next order mein discount ki tarah use kar sakte hain. Scheme 31 Dec 2026 tak valid hai. Kya aap order dena chahenge? 😊
